LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.0.label: Begin Work
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.0.descripti: Retains the chosen Industry awakening. Refinement: production or work benefits. Fractional output carries over. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.1.label: Steady Production
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.1.descripti: Completing the same recipe consecutively with actual industrial material consumption returns 10% of those materials. The first completion establishes the previous recipe. Fractions persist by material type in a colony account; changing recipes updates the record. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.2.label: Flexible Production
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.2.descripti: Completing a different recipe from the previous industrial job returns 15% of the materials actually consumed. The first completion only records the recipe; repeating it gives no changeover return. Fractions and recipe history persist across saves. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.3.label: Measured Stock
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.3.descripti: Complete the same recipe three times in a row to return an additional 7.5% of the industrial materials actually used across the three jobs. Each contribution uses the rate fixed at that time. Completing a different recipe resets an unfinished sequence; editing bills or failed production does not advance it. Fractions carry over, and leaving the branch pauses progress. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.4.label: Batch Settlement
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.4.descripti: Three completions of a recipe reserve 10% of each job’s actual industrial materials at its current rate. Later completions of that recipe redeem up to 10% of each matching material consumed. Remaining supplies persist; redemption jobs do not build another batch. Recipes keep separate records across changeovers and pauses. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.5.label: Work Handoff
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.5.descripti: Completing production reserves 10% of actual industrial materials for one handoff. Another colonist completing a different recipe with real material consumption redeems it. Terms freeze when opened; neither the same worker nor the same recipe can redeem it. Settlement cannot open another order. Fractions persist; leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.6.label: Recipe Records
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.6.descripti: Complete three different manufacturing recipes to reserve 15% of each job’s actual industrial materials at its current rate. Repeating a recipe adds neither records nor stock. Later production redeems up to 10% of matching materials actually consumed; remaining stock persists. A new collection starts only after all stock is used, and redemption jobs add no records. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.7.label: Calibrated Work
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.7.descripti: Each measured-stock settlement reserves an additional 25% of that return as calibrated supplies, frozen when opened. Later production of the same recipe redeems up to 10% of matching materials actually consumed. Keep one order across recipe changes or leaving the branch; a redemption job cannot open another. Ordinary measured-stock returns remain unchanged. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.8.label: Circulating Stock
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.8.descripti: Completing a batch reserves an additional 25% of its supplies in circulating stock, frozen immediately. Stage-three rewards remain unchanged. Later production of any recipe redeems up to 10% of matching industrial materials actually consumed. Keep one reserve and retain unused amounts; redemption cannot refill it in the same job. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.9.label: Cooperative Workshop
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.9.descripti: Three different colonists each complete a different manufacturing recipe to return an extra 7.5% of each job’s actual industrial materials, frozen per contribution. Repeated workers or recipes do not advance it. Settle after the third job without starting another cycle on that completion. Ordinary two-worker handoffs remain active. Progress persists across saves; leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.10.label: Recipe Reuse
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.10.descript: Completing a recipe collection reserves an additional 25% of each recipe’s recorded contribution as dedicated supplies, frozen immediately. Later production of that recipe redeems up to 10% of matching materials actually consumed without spending other recipes’ shares. Keep one set until exhausted; redemption cannot open a replacement set in the same job. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.11.label: Material Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.11.descript: New calibration orders freeze a recovery rate. Redeeming basic stuff such as steel, wood or cloth returns an extra 500% of the calibrated amount; components and chemfuel do not qualify. Ordinary calibrated supplies remain unchanged. Portions redeemed while this branch is inactive do not receive retroactive recovery. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.12.label: Precision Work
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.12.descript: New calibration orders freeze conversion rates using material and component base values. Redemption adds components worth 375% of the calibrated supplies without consuming those supplies. Fractional components persist. Portions redeemed while this branch is inactive earn no retroactive conversion, and returns cannot open orders on their own. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.13.label: Reserve Buffer
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.13.descript: While circulating stock remains, another completed batch may reserve a second allowance at 500% of the normal amount, frozen immediately. Keep at most two and use the older first; the second becomes available on a later job after the first is exhausted. Redemption cannot refill a slot in the same job, and full reserves cannot be overwritten. Leaving this branch freezes the second allowance. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.14.label: Stock Exchange
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.14.descript: New circulating reserves freeze 375% exchange efficiency. Another recipe may spend currently unused stock for industrial materials it actually consumes. Direct and exchanged returns together cannot exceed 10% of each material consumed. Source base values freeze when reserved; target values freeze on first exchange. Leaving the branch pauses conversion; older reserves gain no retroactive terms. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.15.label: Return Shift
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.15.descript: Completing three cooperative jobs freezes an extra 75% of all three contributions as return-shift supplies. The original worker redeems them by completing another manufacturing job with real consumption; others cannot claim them. Keep one order, with no replacement order on its redemption job. Ordinary collaboration continues; leaving this branch pauses redemption. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.16.label: Shared Supplies
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.16.descript: Completing three cooperative jobs freezes an extra 100% of each worker’s contribution as their own share. Each worker claims it by repeating their original recipe with real consumption; others cannot claim or spend it. Keep one set with no replacement on a redemption job. Ordinary collaboration continues; leaving this branch pauses redemption. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.17.label: Specialist Recipes
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.17.descript: When Recipe Reuse opens three shares, reserve an extra 100% of the last completed recipe’s dedicated supplies, frozen immediately. Later production of that recipe redeems up to 10% of matching materials consumed. Keep one reserve, replenished only after it is exhausted and a new collection completes. Leaving the branch pauses it; ordinary shares remain unchanged. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.18.label: Diverse Work
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Industry.nodes.18.descript: When Recipe Reuse opens a set, record an extra 50% of its materials. Pay after all three dedicated recipe shares are exhausted, in any order; repeating one recipe cannot replace another share. Amounts freeze and only one bonus set is retained. Leaving the branch pauses bonus payment while claims remain recorded; eligible production after returning can settle it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
